predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: Guinea, which voted at the referendum of 28 September 1958 and 'declared independence from France on 2 October 1958'

ledger.x: 1958: Guinea rejects the French Community and becomes independent under Sékou Touré.

wars.name: Operation Green Sea
wars.outcome: A Portuguese-led raid on Conakry on the night of 21-22 November 1970 that 'failed to capture Amílcar Cabral' and did not topple the government; 'The attackers withdrew after rescuing the POWs.'

certainty.note: Colonial treaty boundaries: 'France negotiated Guinea's present boundaries in the late 19th and early 20th centuries with the British for Sierra Leone' (the Guinea page); no page opened covers the Liberia, Ivory Coast, Mali, Senegal or…
